prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 155px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 66px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 78px · one-line width 486px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 72px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较主流旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、屏幕技术与价格参数。","reading":"读者先按型号定位一行，再横向查看该机参数，也会沿尺寸、技术或价格列纵向比较；屏幕技术描述较长，是主要的换行来源。","groups":["尺寸和技术同属屏幕参数，应在共同表头下保持清晰的层级；两列的信息密度不同，无须等宽。","型号用于识别行，价格是独立的比较指标；两者应与同一行的屏幕参数容易对应。"],"keep_intact":["手机型号中的品牌和型号标识尽量完整，尤其是数字及 Pro、Ultra 等后缀。","屏幕尺寸中的数字和单位、价格中的数字及货币单位应尽量保持完整。","屏幕技术中的 AMOLED、OLED、LTPO、120Hz 等标识应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术描述可在标点、空格或自然词组边界处换行；较高的技术单元格也可容纳同一行型号或价格的换行。","较长的手机型号可在品牌与型号之间换行，避免拆开型号标识。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [100, 55, 145, 59] · table 360×779px · row heights [36, 36, 106, 106, 106, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [95, 55, 120, 89] · table 360×942px · row heights [36, 36, 153, 129, 129, 153, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [90, 87, 133, 49] · table 360×872px · row heights [36, 36, 129, 129, 106, 129, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 6

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"整体最紧凑，屏幕技术列较宽，六个型号的参数行都比较容易横向对应；尺寸和价格的数字也能保持完整。两级屏幕表头清楚。","problems":"型号普遍换成两三行，尺寸的数字与“英寸”分行；技术描述仍有较多短行，部分刷新率范围在连字符处断开。价格的数字和“元起”分行。","cause":"技术列为145px，占用较多宽度；型号列100px、尺寸列55px、价格列59px分别只有79px、34px、38px的文字空间，无法容纳这些内容的完整单行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"尺寸和价格数字保持完整，价格列较宽，数字与“元”可以同排；表头层级清楚。","problems":"技术描述被挤成许多短行，表格明显变长，纵向比较需要更多滚动；价格列相对内容偏宽，却仍把“起”留到下一行，型号也有较多换行。","cause":"价格列增加到89px，技术列降至120px，只剩99px文字空间；型号列95px也不足以容纳较长的型号标识。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"尺寸列较宽，数字和“英寸”能放在同一行，纵向比较尺寸方便；屏幕分组仍可辨认。","problems":"价格表头竖向换行，价格数字被拆开，严重妨碍比较；型号和技术描述也较碎，整表节奏不均。","cause":"尺寸列87px占用较多宽度，价格列仅49px、文字空间只有28px，低于价格数字及表头所需宽度；型号列90px也较窄。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"A-refined","widths":[105,55,140,59],"change":"以r1A为基础，将5px从技术列移给型号列，尝试改善型号识别，同时保留完整价格数字和较宽的技术列。"},{"name":"price-together","widths":[95,55,116,93],"change":"进一步测试较宽价格列，尝试让价格及“元起”同排；观察更窄的技术列造成的高度代价是否值得。"},{"name":"size-balanced","widths":[95,76,129,59],"change":"给尺寸列足够空间容纳数字和单位，同时保留可显示完整价格数字的宽度；检验尺寸单行带来的扫描收益与技术列变窄的取舍。"}]}
